Booked for my family ( mum, sister & me) a connecting room.
It was a family suite, with a living room and master bedroom with a queen bed + another room with 2 single beds.

Came equipped with a mini kitchen, laundry machine, big fridge and all the cutlery too! Was really impressed with the amenities provided 👌🏻Room was impeccably clean & water pressure + heater was working well.

The living room was perfect for relaxing after a long day out or eating snacks that we bought from the day’s trip.

The hotel pool was clean and decent sized, with a steam room, small gym ( treadmills + some free weights).

I went for a private Pilates class in the hotel’s wellness facility & the instructor guided me along in English quite smoothly 🥰

Everything in this hotel was perfect, zen garden with a beautiful Koi pond + a very instagram worthy wooden spiral staircase in the middle! 👀✨

The only thing I would gripe about perhaps is the location is a just a little far from the old city where the hubbub is for you to visit the markets & bars! But nothing a quick 100 baht grab ride in can’t fix 🫶🏻 the cab drivers are familiar with the hotel’s location ☺️

Also breakfast is not provided 🙃 and has to be paid separately at 400baht per person which is a little pricey compared to the other hotels in Thailand. It’s a fixed set as well which you have to select from :( It’s a huge breakfast with mains, salad, cut fruit, hot coffee/tea, glass of milk , orange juice & small serving of yoghurt.

You’re better off ordering ala carte from their Welladee Cafe, their food range is bigger + their coffee is really good ♥️Highly recommend their NZ beef krapow, I miss it already 🥲

Over all I would rate this 4.5/5 ⭐️ and definitely would be recommending Welladee for a good stay in CNX🌼
